name: Minimal Developer
imitationRules: one core idea per slide
large titles and restrained accent colors
use code line highlighting and v-click reveals
avoid decorative clutter

name: Elegant Technical Keynote
imitationRules: use a strong cover image with a readable overlay
create ceremonial section dividers
synchronize code animations with the spoken narrative
keep content pages calm

name: AI Infra Dark
imitationRules: standardize nodes, connectors, cards, and chart colors
keep text contrast accessible on dark backgrounds
make each metrics slide support one conclusion
use consistent spacing and border tokens

name: Visual Research Narrative
imitationRules: build a clear evidence timeline
crop and annotate screenshots precisely
connect technical fragments to a storyline
avoid drowning the conclusion in raw evidence

name: Formal Academic
imitationRules: clarify question, method, experiment, and conclusion
number figures and cite sources
use precise language instead of marketing language
maintain a restrained color palette

name: Friendly Education
imitationRules: one knowledge point per slide
introduce code examples progressively
use checklists and exercises
prefer approachable illustrations and spacing

name: Chinese Product UI
imitationRules: use slightly larger Chinese type and short paragraphs
standardize product screenshot framing
explain capability boundaries with cards and tables
avoid translated English boilerplate

name: Hand-drawn Whiteboard
imitationRules: use thick strokes and marker-style emphasis
favor diagrams over polished gradients
show problem decomposition
keep the visual voice intentionally informal

name: SVG / Diagram Editorial
imitationRules: make the diagram the protagonist
unify line weight, color, and captions
place code and rendered result side by side
use whitespace to separate visual steps

name: Large-Type Impact
imitationRules: one phrase or number per slide
put narration in presenter notes
use transitions to form an argument chain
remove secondary text
